slot_scores.name: project1_investment_timing
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Can you invest in project (1) at the beginning of any of the three years, or is it restricted to specific years?
slot_scores.rationale: Directly asks whether project (1) can be invested in any of the three years, covering the flexible multi-year timing.

slot_scores.name: project1_reinvestment_rule
slot_scores.evidence_quote: For project (1), is the 20% annual profit paid out at the end of each year with the principal remaining available for reinvestment, or is the principal locked up for a specific period?
slot_scores.rationale: Explicitly asks about project (1) profit payout and principal availability for reinvestment, targeting the reinvestment rule.

slot_scores.name: project2_recovery_timing
slot_scores.evidence_quote: For project (2), does the 150% total return mean you receive 150% of the invested amount (i.e., 50% profit plus principal) at the end of the third year, or does it mean you receive 150% profit on top of the principal?
slot_scores.rationale: Mentions project (2) payout timing but embeds the incorrect end-of-third-year recovery and does not ask for or confirm recovery at the end of year 2.

slot_scores.name: project3_investment_timing
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Can you invest in project (3) at the beginning of any of the three years, or is it restricted to specific years?
slot_scores.rationale: Directly asks about project (3) investment timing; user confirms only the beginning of year 2.

slot_scores.name: project4_investment_timing
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Can you invest in project (4) at the beginning of any of the three years, or is it restricted to specific years?
slot_scores.rationale: Directly asks about project (4) investment timing; user confirms only the beginning of year 3.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: Project (2) funds are recovered at the end of Year 2.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never directly asked about project (2)'s recovery date; the timing came from a user-simulator correction to a return-definition question, so it was not recovered through the agent's own targeted confirmation.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The agent entered READY_TO_MODEL after addressing most P1 slots, but H3 (project (2) recovery timing) remained only partially resolved and directly unasked, so stopping was premature.

summary: The agent did well on project (1) timing/reinvestment and projects (3)/(4) timing, but it missed the direct project (2) recovery-timing question and relied on a user correction. It stopped at READY_TO_MODEL with that P1 slot unresolved, so the interaction is not fully complete.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
